caveat: A published keynote, deliberately polemical: nine references, no data, and the ideology argument is applied to others but not to its own position.
source: Journal watch: Educational Philosophy and Theory · full text read 28 Sep
title: What did critical thinking ever do for us? Teaching critical thinking in the age of AI
why: A philosopher's case that critical thinking is dispositional (charity, humility, courage, resilience) rather than a skill set, and that AI use plus crisis rhetoric erode the conditions for it. Sits directly on your Professional Criticality line.
